forks.question: When a failed join is retried, should its count of earlier crash interruptions reset?

options.says: Retrying a failed join resets the crash-interruption count, giving that retry the full interruption allowance.

model.name: recording pieces

statements.name: Spec
statements.says: The recording starts in Init and changes only through Next steps.

statements.name: ClosedPiecesProtected
statements.says: Closed pieces are never changed, and none is removed or requested for removal before confirmed hand-over and the end of the three-day retention period.

statements.name: NameRequiresFlushedBytes
statements.says: A piece is requested to receive its name only after the caller has reported all of its bytes flushed to disk.

statements.name: SavedGapsSurviveNaming
statements.says: The omitted pieces and their gap durations are saved before the joined file receives its name and remain available unchanged after it is named.

statements.name: WholeMeansNamed
statements.says: Only pieces with their names on disk count as whole, apart from a removal already in progress after retention.

statements.name: RecoveryUsesNamedPieces
statements.says: After recovery the record agrees with the named pieces on disk, allowing only an outstanding naming or removal acknowledgement to lag behind disk.

statements.name: FreshPieceNumber
statements.says: Each new piece uses the number after the last named piece and never reuses a closed piece number.

statements.name: NoReuseBeforeDiscard
statements.says: Open-piece leftovers are discarded before their number is reused or a join is requested, and never count as closed pieces.

statements.name: WriteFailureStopsCapture
statements.says: A failed piece write prevents any further piece from that capture and reports that the recording cannot go on.

statements.name: JoinHasEveryClosedPiece
statements.says: A join is requested only after final capture end with no piece open, and includes every closed piece once in number order.

statements.name: NamedJoinIsComplete
statements.says: A named joined file is complete and contains at least one readable closed piece.

statements.name: UnreadablePiecesAreKept
statements.says: Pieces omitted as unreadable stay in the spool with the other closed pieces until hand-over and the retention period have passed.

statements.name: OnlyJoinedFileHandedOver
statements.says: Every hand-over uses the same recording identity and joined file, and the caller deduplicates retries so no piece or second file is handed over.

statements.name: HandedOverMeansConfirmed
statements.says: The recording counts as handed over only after confirmation of its joined file, and its retention period cannot expire before that confirmation.

statements.name: FailureKeepsTheRecording
statements.says: A failed join or hand-over keeps every closed piece and supplies its error and spool location, and a failed join hands over nothing.

statements.name: NoJoinOverExistingFile
statements.says: A whole joined file found on recovery is used for hand-over instead of attempting another join at its occupied name.

statements.name: NoEmptyJoin
statements.says: Finishing a recording with no closed piece reports that nothing was recorded and produces no join or hand-over.

statements.name: InterruptionLimitReportsFailure
statements.says: Reaching the interruption limit reports a failed join and waits for a new retry trigger after discarding any partial join.

statements.name: FailedRetryBudget
statements.says: Retrying a failed join resets its crash-interruption count to zero.

statements.name: TypeOK
statements.says: Every record field, command, caller effect and proof observation has its declared type.

statements.name: EmptyRecordingPossible
statements.says: A recording can finish with nothing recorded.

statements.name: ClosedRecordingPossible
statements.says: All closed pieces can be joined and handed over successfully.

statements.name: GappedRecordingPossible
statements.says: A recording can be handed over with an unreadable piece omitted, its gap duration reported and its original pieces retained.

statements.name: JoinFailurePossible
statements.says: A join can fail while retaining its closed pieces.

statements.name: AllUnreadableFailurePossible
statements.says: A join that cannot read any piece can fail without handing anything over.

statements.name: JoinRetryPossible
statements.says: A failed join can be attempted again with its closed pieces.

statements.name: HandFailurePossible
statements.says: Hand-over can fail while the joined file and all pieces are retained.

statements.name: HandRetryPossible
statements.says: A failed hand-over can be attempted again with the same identity and file.

statements.name: WriteFailurePossible
statements.says: A failed piece write can stop capture and leave earlier closed pieces ready to finish.

statements.name: InterruptedJoinLimitPossible
statements.says: Repeated crashes can reach the join interruption limit and report failure.

statements.name: FailedRetryAfterInterruptionPossible
statements.says: A join that failed at the interruption limit can be retried.

statements.name: CarryOnAfterRecoveryPossible
statements.says: A recording can carry on after recovery by writing the piece after its last closed piece.

statements.name: UnacknowledgedPieceCrashPossible
statements.says: A crash can occur after a piece receives its name but before its closure is recorded.

statements.name: UnacknowledgedJoinCrashPossible
statements.says: A crash can occur after a joined file with gaps receives its name but before join success is recorded.

statements.name: UnacknowledgedHandCrashPossible
statements.says: A crash can occur after successful hand-over but before its success is recorded.

statements.name: RemovalPossible
statements.says: All pieces can be removed after hand-over and the three-day retention period.

statements.name: OpenDiscardPossible
statements.says: An incomplete open piece can reach discard after a failure or crash.

statements.name: JoinDispatchProgress
statements.says: Once the caller has finished any required cleanup, a queued join is eventually requested if On Air stays running.

statements.name: HandDispatchProgress
statements.says: A queued hand-over is eventually requested if On Air stays running.

statements.name: RemovalDispatchProgress
statements.says: Removal is eventually requested after the retention-expired input if On Air stays running.

statements.name: JoinDispatchFairness
statements.says: The bookkeeping eventually issues a join request that remains ready.

statements.name: HandDispatchFairness
statements.says: The bookkeeping eventually issues a hand-over request that remains ready.

statements.name: RemovalDispatchFairness
statements.says: The bookkeeping eventually issues a removal request that remains ready.

statements.name: BugEarlyRemoval
statements.says: A mistaken implementation removes a piece as soon as its join succeeds, before hand-over.

statements.name: BugNameBeforeFlush
statements.says: A mistaken implementation requests a piece name while only partial bytes are on disk.

statements.name: BugLoseSavedGap
statements.says: A mistaken implementation forgets saved gap durations after the joined file receives its name.

model.module_text:
---- MODULE RecordingPieces ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS MaxPieces, MaxInterruptions, MaxGapSeconds, Recording, JoinedFile, SpoolPath, ResetOnFailedRetry
VARIABLES online, phase, mode, known, disk, everClosed, open, hidden,
    writeBlocked, joinInput, joinTemp, joinedNamed, omitted, gaps,
    callerGaps, fileGaps, handed, archive, handKey, handTarget,
    keepPassed, interruptions, cutoff, error, retryBefore, retryAfter,
    changedClosed, recovered

\* One instance models one recording, identified by Recording, through its
\* lifetime. Bounds limit exploration, not production recording length.
\* Controller transitions save their complete record atomically before their
\* command can be executed. Disk and archive variables model caller reports and
\* effects; this component performs no I/O. Disk effects and acknowledgements
\* are separate so every relevant crash window is explored.
\* everClosed, changedClosed and retryBefore/retryAfter are proof observations.
\* The caller owns flushing, durable names, read-only joins, time measurement,
\* and hand-over deduplication by Recording. No progress is assumed of it.

vars == <<online, phase, mode, known, disk, everClosed, open, hidden, writeBlocked, joinInput, joinTemp, joinedNamed, omitted, gaps, callerGaps, fileGaps, handed, archive, handKey, handTarget, keepPassed, interruptions, cutoff, error, retryBefore, retryAfter, changedClosed, recovered>>

Pieces == 1..MaxPieces

Phases == {"capture", "paused", "write", "name", "discardOpen", "empty", "needJoin", "join", "nameJoin", "discardJoin", "joinFailed", "needHand", "hand", "handFailed", "kept", "needRemove", "remove", "done"}

JoinErrors == {"join-io", "all-unreadable", "interrupted"}

EmptyGaps == [p \in {} |-> 0]

GapMaps == UNION { [s -> 1..MaxGapSeconds] : s \in SUBSET Pieces }

LastNamed == IF disk = {} THEN 0 ELSE CHOOSE p \in disk : \A q \in disk : q <= p

\* The finite sequence below is derived from the bound; no two-piece limit is
\* part of the contract. TLC's function-to-sequence interpretation is standard.
OrderedPieces(s) == LET n == Cardinality(s)
                       rank == [p \in s |-> Cardinality({q \in s : q <= p})]
                   IN [i \in 1..n |-> CHOOSE p \in s : rank[p] = i]

AfterCapture == IF mode = "active" THEN "capture" ELSE IF mode = "paused" THEN "paused" ELSE IF disk = {} THEN "empty" ELSE "needJoin"

FailedRetryCount == IF ResetOnFailedRetry THEN 0 ELSE interruptions

Outcome == [status |-> phase, error |-> error, spool |-> SpoolPath,
            cannotContinue |-> writeBlocked, omitted |-> omitted, gaps |-> gaps]

ClosedPiecesProtected ==
    /\ ~changedClosed
    /\ (~(handed /\ keepPassed) => disk = everClosed)
    /\ (online /\ phase \in {"needRemove", "remove", "done"} => handed /\ keepPassed)

NameRequiresFlushedBytes ==
    online /\ phase = "name" /\ open \notin disk => hidden = "flushed"

WholeMeansNamed ==
    /\ disk \subseteq everClosed
    /\ (online /\ phase # "remove" => known \subseteq disk)

RecoveryUsesNamedPieces ==
    online /\ phase \notin {"name", "remove"} => known = disk

FreshPieceNumber ==
    online /\ phase = "write" => open = LastNamed + 1 /\ open \notin everClosed

NoReuseBeforeDiscard ==
    /\ (online /\ phase \in {"capture", "paused", "empty", "needJoin", "join", "nameJoin", "needHand", "hand", "handFailed", "kept", "needRemove", "remove", "done"} => open = 0 /\ hidden = "absent")
    /\ (hidden # "absent" => open \in Pieces /\ open \notin disk)

WriteFailureStopsCapture ==
    writeBlocked => mode # "active" /\ phase \notin {"write", "name", "capture"}

JoinHasEveryClosedPiece ==
    online /\ phase \in {"join", "nameJoin"} =>
        mode = "final" /\ open = 0 /\ hidden = "absent" /\ disk # {} /\ joinInput = OrderedPieces(disk)

NamedJoinIsComplete ==
    joinedNamed => joinTemp = "absent" /\ Len(joinInput) > 0 /\ omitted \subseteq everClosed /\ omitted # everClosed

SavedGapsSurviveNaming ==
    /\ DOMAIN gaps = omitted
    /\ (phase = "nameJoin" \/ joinedNamed => gaps = callerGaps)
    /\ (joinedNamed => gaps = fileGaps)

UnreadablePiecesAreKept ==
    ~(handed /\ keepPassed) => omitted \subseteq disk

OnlyJoinedFileHandedOver ==
    /\ archive \subseteq {<<Recording, JoinedFile>>}
    /\ (phase = "hand" => handKey = Recording /\ handTarget = JoinedFile /\ joinedNamed)
    /\ (handKey # "none" => handKey = Recording /\ handTarget = JoinedFile)

HandedOverMeansConfirmed ==
    /\ (handed => <<Recording, JoinedFile>> \in archive /\ joinedNamed)
    /\ (keepPassed => handed)

FailureKeepsTheRecording ==
    phase \in {"joinFailed", "handFailed"} =>
        ~handed /\ disk = everClosed /\ Outcome.spool = SpoolPath /\
        IF phase = "joinFailed"
        THEN ~joinedNamed /\ archive = {} /\ error \in JoinErrors
        ELSE joinedNamed /\ error = "hand-io"

NoJoinOverExistingFile ==
    online /\ phase \in {"needJoin", "join", "discardJoin", "joinFailed"} => ~joinedNamed

NoEmptyJoin ==
    phase = "empty" => mode = "final" /\ disk = {} /\ ~joinedNamed /\ archive = {}

InterruptionLimitReportsFailure ==
    /\ (cutoff => interruptions = MaxInterruptions /\ error = "interrupted" /\ phase \in {"discardJoin", "joinFailed"})
    /\ (phase = "joinFailed" /\ error = "interrupted" => interruptions = MaxInterruptions)

FailedRetryBudget ==
    retryAfter = IF ResetOnFailedRetry THEN 0 ELSE retryBefore

TypeOK ==
    /\ MaxPieces \in Nat \ {0}
    /\ MaxInterruptions \in Nat \ {0}
    /\ MaxGapSeconds \in Nat \ {0}
    /\ ResetOnFailedRetry \in BOOLEAN
    /\ online \in BOOLEAN
    /\ phase \in Phases
    /\ mode \in {"active", "paused", "final"}
    /\ known \subseteq Pieces
    /\ disk \subseteq Pieces
    /\ everClosed \subseteq Pieces
    /\ open \in 0..MaxPieces
    /\ hidden \in {"absent", "partial", "flushed"}
    /\ writeBlocked \in BOOLEAN
    /\ joinInput \in Seq(Pieces)
    /\ Len(joinInput) <= MaxPieces
    /\ joinTemp \in {"absent", "partial", "whole"}
    /\ joinedNamed \in BOOLEAN
    /\ omitted \subseteq Pieces
    /\ gaps \in GapMaps
    /\ callerGaps \in GapMaps
    /\ fileGaps \in GapMaps
    /\ handed \in BOOLEAN
    /\ archive \subseteq ({Recording} \X {JoinedFile, "piece"})
    /\ handKey \in {"none", Recording}
    /\ handTarget \in {"none", JoinedFile, "piece"}
    /\ keepPassed \in BOOLEAN
    /\ interruptions \in 0..MaxInterruptions
    /\ cutoff \in BOOLEAN
    /\ error \in {"none", "write-io", "hand-io"} \cup JoinErrors
    /\ retryBefore \in 0..MaxInterruptions
    /\ retryAfter \in 0..MaxInterruptions
    /\ changedClosed \in BOOLEAN
    /\ recovered \in BOOLEAN

EmptyRecordingPossible == phase = "empty"

ClosedRecordingPossible == handed /\ omitted = {} /\ disk # {}

GappedRecordingPossible == handed /\ omitted # {} /\ gaps = fileGaps /\ omitted \subseteq disk

JoinFailurePossible == phase = "joinFailed" /\ error = "join-io" /\ disk # {}

AllUnreadableFailurePossible == phase = "joinFailed" /\ error = "all-unreadable"

JoinRetryPossible == phase = "join" /\ error \in JoinErrors

HandFailurePossible == phase = "handFailed" /\ disk # {}

HandRetryPossible == phase = "hand" /\ error = "hand-io"

WriteFailurePossible == writeBlocked /\ phase = "needJoin" /\ disk # {}

InterruptedJoinLimitPossible == phase = "joinFailed" /\ cutoff

FailedRetryAfterInterruptionPossible == phase = "join" /\ retryBefore = MaxInterruptions

CarryOnAfterRecoveryPossible == recovered /\ phase = "write" /\ open = 2 /\ disk = {1}

UnacknowledgedPieceCrashPossible == ~online /\ phase = "name" /\ disk # known

UnacknowledgedJoinCrashPossible == ~online /\ phase = "nameJoin" /\ joinedNamed /\ omitted # {}

UnacknowledgedHandCrashPossible == ~online /\ phase = "hand" /\ archive # {} /\ ~handed

RemovalPossible == phase = "done" /\ disk = {} /\ everClosed # {} /\ handed /\ keepPassed

OpenDiscardPossible == phase = "discardOpen" /\ hidden = "partial"

JoinDispatchProgress == (online /\ phase = "needJoin") ~> (~online \/ phase = "join")

HandDispatchProgress == (online /\ phase = "needHand") ~> (~online \/ phase = "hand")

RemovalDispatchProgress == (online /\ phase = "needRemove") ~> (~online \/ phase = "remove")

Init ==
    /\ online = TRUE
    /\ phase = "capture"
    /\ mode = "active"
    /\ known = {}
    /\ disk = {}
    /\ everClosed = {}
    /\ open = 0
    /\ hidden = "absent"
    /\ writeBlocked = FALSE
    /\ joinInput = <<>>
    /\ joinTemp = "absent"
    /\ joinedNamed = FALSE
    /\ omitted = {}
    /\ gaps = EmptyGaps
    /\ callerGaps = EmptyGaps
    /\ fileGaps = EmptyGaps
    /\ handed = FALSE
    /\ archive = {}
    /\ handKey = "none"
    /\ handTarget = "none"
    /\ keepPassed = FALSE
    /\ interruptions = 0
    /\ cutoff = FALSE
    /\ error = "none"
    /\ retryBefore = 0
    /\ retryAfter = 0
    /\ changedClosed = FALSE
    /\ recovered = FALSE

RequestPiece(p) ==
    /\ online
    /\ phase = "capture"
    /\ mode = "active"
    /\ ~writeBlocked
    /\ open = 0
    /\ hidden = "absent"
    /\ p = LastNamed + 1
    /\ p \in Pieces
    /\ phase' = ("write")
    /\ open' = (p)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<online, mode, known, disk, everClosed, hidden, writeBlocked, joinInput, joinTemp, joinedNamed, omitted, gaps, callerGaps, fileGaps, handed, archive, handKey, handTarget, keepPassed, interruptions, cutoff, error, retryBefore, retryAfter, changedClosed, recovered>>

WritePartial ==
    /\ online
    /\ phase = "write"
    /\ hidden = "absent"
    /\ hidden' = ("partial")
    /\ UNCHANGED <<online, phase, mode, known, disk, everClosed, open, writeBlocked, joinInput, joinTemp, joinedNamed, omitted, gaps, callerGaps, fileGaps, handed, archive, handKey, handTarget, keepPassed, interruptions, cutoff, error, retryBefore, retryAfter, changedClosed, recovered>>

FlushPiece ==
    /\ online
    /\ phase = "write"
    /\ hidden \in {"absent", "partial"}
    /\ hidden' = ("flushed")
    /\ UNCHANGED <<online, phase, mode, known, disk, everClosed, open, writeBlocked, joinInput, joinTemp, joinedNamed, omitted, gaps, callerGaps, fileGaps, handed, archive, handKey, handTarget, keepPassed, interruptions, cutoff, error, retryBefore, retryAfter, changedClosed, recovered>>

ReportWritten ==
    /\ online
    /\ phase = "write"
    /\ hidden = "flushed"
    /\ phase' = ("name")
    /\ UNCHANGED <<online, mode, known, disk, everClosed, open, hidden, writeBlocked, joinInput, joinTemp, joinedNamed, omitted, gaps, callerGaps, fileGaps, handed, archive, handKey, handTarget, keepPassed, interruptions, cutoff, error, retryBefore, retryAfter, changedClosed, recovered>>

NamePiece ==
    /\ online
    /\ phase = "name"
    /\ hidden = "flushed"
    /\ open \notin disk
    /\ hidden' = ("absent")
    /\ disk' = (disk \cup {open})
    /\ everClosed' = (everClosed \cup {open})
    /\ UNCHANGED <<online, phase, mode, known, open, writeBlocked, joinInput, joinTemp, joinedNamed, omitted, gaps, callerGaps, fileGaps, handed, archive, handKey, handTarget, keepPassed, interruptions, cutoff, error, retryBefore, retryAfter, changedClosed, recovered>>

ReportClosed ==
    /\ online
    /\ phase = "name"
    /\ open \in disk
    /\ phase' = (AfterCapture)
    /\ known' = (disk)
    /\ open' = (0)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<online, mode, disk, everClosed, hidden, writeBlocked, joinInput, joinTemp, joinedNamed, omitted, gaps, callerGaps, fileGaps, handed, archive, handKey, handTarget, keepPassed, interruptions, cutoff, error, retryBefore, retryAfter, changedClosed, recovered>>

ReportWriteFailure ==
    /\ online
    /\ phase \in {"write", "name"}
    /\ open \notin disk
    /\ phase' = ("discardOpen")
    /\ writeBlocked' = (TRUE)
    /\ mode' = (IF mode = "final" THEN "final" ELSE "paused")
    /\ error' = ("write-io")
    /\ UNCHANGED <<online, known, disk, everClosed, open, hidden, joinInput, joinTemp, joinedNamed, omitted, gaps, callerGaps, fileGaps, handed, archive, handKey, handTarget, keepPassed, interruptions, cutoff, retryBefore, retryAfter, changedClosed, recovered>>

DiscardOpenBytes ==
    /\ online
    /\ phase = "discardOpen"
    /\ hidden # "absent"
    /\ hidden' = ("absent")
    /\ UNCHANGED <<online, phase, mode, known, disk, everClosed, open, writeBlocked, joinInput, joinTemp, joinedNamed, omitted, gaps, callerGaps, fileGaps, handed, archive, handKey, handTarget, keepPassed, interruptions, cutoff, error, retryBefore, retryAfter, changedClosed, recovered>>

ReportOpenDiscarded ==
    /\ online
    /\ phase = "discardOpen"
    /\ hidden = "absent"
    /\ open' = (0)
    /\ phase' = (IF mode = "final" THEN IF disk = {} THEN "empty" ELSE "needJoin" ELSE "paused")
    /\ UNCHANGED <<online, mode, known, disk, everClosed, hidden, writeBlocked, joinInput, joinTemp, joinedNamed, omitted, gaps, callerGaps, fileGaps, handed, archive, handKey, handTarget, keepPassed, interruptions, cutoff, error, retryBefore, retryAfter, changedClosed, recovered>>

CaptureEnded ==
    /\ online
    /\ mode = "active"
    /\ phase \in {"capture", "write", "name"}
    /\ mode' = ("paused")
    /\ phase' = (IF phase = "capture" THEN "paused" ELSE phase)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<online, known, disk, everClosed, open, hidden, writeBlocked, joinInput, joinTemp, joinedNamed, omitted, gaps, callerGaps, fileGaps, handed, archive, handKey, handTarget, keepPassed, interruptions, cutoff, error, retryBefore, retryAfter, changedClosed, recovered>>

CarryOn ==
    /\ online
    /\ phase = "paused"
    /\ mode = "paused"
    /\ ~writeBlocked
    /\ LastNamed < MaxPieces
    /\ mode' = ("active")
    /\ phase' = ("capture")
    /\ UNCHANGED <<online, known, disk, everClosed, open, hidden, writeBlocked, joinInput, joinTemp, joinedNamed, omitted, gaps, callerGaps, fileGaps, handed, archive, handKey, handTarget, keepPassed, interruptions, cutoff, error, retryBefore, retryAfter, changedClosed, recovered>>

FinishRecording ==
    /\ online
    /\ mode # "final"
    /\ phase \in {"capture", "paused", "write", "name", "discardOpen"}
    /\ mode' = ("final")
    /\ phase' = (IF phase \in {"capture", "paused"} THEN IF disk = {} THEN "empty" ELSE "needJoin" ELSE phase)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<online, known, disk, everClosed, open, hidden, writeBlocked, joinInput, joinTemp, joinedNamed, omitted, gaps, callerGaps, fileGaps, handed, archive, handKey, handTarget, keepPassed, interruptions, cutoff, error, retryBefore, retryAfter, changedClosed, recovered>>

IssueJoin ==
    /\ online
    /\ phase = "needJoin"
    /\ mode = "final"
    /\ open = 0
    /\ hidden = "absent"
    /\ disk # {}
    /\ ~joinedNamed
    /\ joinTemp = "absent"
    /\ phase' = ("join")
    /\ joinInput' = (OrderedPieces(disk))
    /\ omitted' = ({})
    /\ gaps' = (EmptyGaps)
    /\ callerGaps' = (EmptyGaps)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<online, mode, known, disk, everClosed, open, hidden, writeBlocked, joinTemp, joinedNamed, fileGaps, handed, archive, handKey, handTarget, keepPassed, interruptions, cutoff, error, retryBefore, retryAfter, changedClosed, recovered>>

WriteJoinPartial ==
    /\ online
    /\ phase = "join"
    /\ joinTemp = "absent"
    /\ joinTemp' = ("partial")
    /\ UNCHANGED <<online, phase, mode, known, disk, everClosed, open, hidden, writeBlocked, joinInput, joinedNamed, omitted, gaps, callerGaps, fileGaps, handed, archive, handKey, handTarget, keepPassed, interruptions, cutoff, error, retryBefore, retryAfter, changedClosed, recovered>>

\* A successful caller report means that every input except skipped was read
\* into the complete file and each omitted interval is a time jump of the
\* reported duration in seconds. Encoding and decoding are outside this model.
\* This atomic record save must complete before NameJoinedFile can run.

ReportJoinReady(skipped, durations) ==
    /\ online
    /\ phase = "join"
    /\ skipped \subseteq disk
    /\ skipped # disk
    /\ durations \in [skipped -> 1..MaxGapSeconds]
    /\ phase' = ("nameJoin")
    /\ joinTemp' = ("whole")
    /\ omitted' = (skipped)
    /\ gaps' = (durations)
    /\ callerGaps' = (durations)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<online, mode, known, disk, everClosed, open, hidden, writeBlocked, joinInput, joinedNamed, fileGaps, handed, archive, handKey, handTarget, keepPassed, interruptions, cutoff, error, retryBefore, retryAfter, changedClosed, recovered>>

NameJoinedFile ==
    /\ online
    /\ phase = "nameJoin"
    /\ joinTemp = "whole"
    /\ ~joinedNamed
    /\ gaps = callerGaps
    /\ DOMAIN gaps = omitted
    /\ joinedNamed' = (TRUE)
    /\ joinTemp' = ("absent")
    /\ fileGaps' = (gaps)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<online, phase, mode, known, disk, everClosed, open, hidden, writeBlocked, joinInput, omitted, gaps, callerGaps, handed, archive, handKey, handTarget, keepPassed, interruptions, cutoff, error, retryBefore, retryAfter, changedClosed, recovered>>

ReportJoined ==
    /\ online
    /\ phase = "nameJoin"
    /\ joinedNamed
    /\ phase' = ("needHand")
    /\ error' = ("none")
    /\ UNCHANGED <<online, mode, known, disk, everClosed, open, hidden, writeBlocked, joinInput, joinTemp, joinedNamed, omitted, gaps, callerGaps, fileGaps, handed, archive, handKey, handTarget, keepPassed, interruptions, cutoff, retryBefore, retryAfter, changedClosed, recovered>>

ReportJoinFailure(reason) ==
    /\ online
    /\ phase = "join"
    /\ reason \in {"join-io", "all-unreadable"}
    /\ phase' = ("joinFailed")
    /\ error' = (reason)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<online, mode, known, disk, everClosed, open, hidden, writeBlocked, joinInput, joinTemp, joinedNamed, omitted, gaps, callerGaps, fileGaps, handed, archive, handKey, handTarget, keepPassed, interruptions, cutoff, retryBefore, retryAfter, changedClosed, recovered>>

PersonRetriesJoin ==
    /\ online
    /\ phase = "joinFailed"
    /\ phase' = ("discardJoin")
    /\ cutoff' = (FALSE)
    /\ interruptions' = (FailedRetryCount)
    /\ retryBefore' = (interruptions)
    /\ retryAfter' = (FailedRetryCount)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<online, mode, known, disk, everClosed, open, hidden, writeBlocked, joinInput, joinTemp, joinedNamed, omitted, gaps, callerGaps, fileGaps, handed, archive, handKey, handTarget, keepPassed, error, changedClosed, recovered>>

DiscardJoinPartial ==
    /\ online
    /\ phase = "discardJoin"
    /\ ~joinedNamed
    /\ joinTemp # "absent"
    /\ joinTemp' = ("absent")
    /\ UNCHANGED <<online, phase, mode, known, disk, everClosed, open, hidden, writeBlocked, joinInput, joinedNamed, omitted, gaps, callerGaps, fileGaps, handed, archive, handKey, handTarget, keepPassed, interruptions, cutoff, error, retryBefore, retryAfter, changedClosed, recovered>>

ReportJoinPartialDiscarded ==
    /\ online
    /\ phase = "discardJoin"
    /\ joinTemp = "absent"
    /\ phase' = (IF cutoff THEN "joinFailed" ELSE "needJoin")
    /\ omitted' = ({})
    /\ gaps' = (EmptyGaps)
    /\ callerGaps' = (EmptyGaps)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<online, mode, known, disk, everClosed, open, hidden, writeBlocked, joinInput, joinTemp, joinedNamed, fileGaps, handed, archive, handKey, handTarget, keepPassed, interruptions, cutoff, error, retryBefore, retryAfter, changedClosed, recovered>>

IssueHandOver ==
    /\ online
    /\ phase = "needHand"
    /\ joinedNamed
    /\ phase' = ("hand")
    /\ handKey' = (Recording)
    /\ handTarget' = (JoinedFile)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<online, mode, known, disk, everClosed, open, hidden, writeBlocked, joinInput, joinTemp, joinedNamed, omitted, gaps, callerGaps, fileGaps, handed, archive, keepPassed, interruptions, cutoff, error, retryBefore, retryAfter, changedClosed, recovered>>

CallerCopiesJoinedFile ==
    /\ online
    /\ phase = "hand"
    /\ archive = {}
    /\ archive' = ({<<handKey, handTarget>>})
    /\ UNCHANGED <<online, phase, mode, known, disk, everClosed, open, hidden, writeBlocked, joinInput, joinTemp, joinedNamed, omitted, gaps, callerGaps, fileGaps, handed, handKey, handTarget, keepPassed, interruptions, cutoff, error, retryBefore, retryAfter, changedClosed, recovered>>

ReportHandOverSuccess ==
    /\ online
    /\ phase = "hand"
    /\ <<Recording, JoinedFile>> \in archive
    /\ handed' = (TRUE)
    /\ phase' = ("kept")

pins.name: Spec
pins.says: The recording starts in Init and changes only through Next steps.

pins.name: ClosedPiecesProtected
pins.says: Closed pieces are never changed, and none is removed or requested for removal before confirmed hand-over and the end of the three-day retention period.

pins.name: NameRequiresFlushedBytes
pins.says: A piece is requested to receive its name only after the caller has reported all of its bytes flushed to disk.

pins.name: SavedGapsSurviveNaming
pins.says: The omitted pieces and their gap durations are saved before the joined file receives its name and remain available unchanged after it is named.

pins.name: WholeMeansNamed
pins.says: Only pieces with their names on disk count as whole, apart from a removal already in progress after retention.

pins.name: RecoveryUsesNamedPieces
pins.says: After recovery the record agrees with the named pieces on disk, allowing only an outstanding naming or removal acknowledgement to lag behind disk.

pins.name: FreshPieceNumber
pins.says: Each new piece uses the number after the last named piece and never reuses a closed piece number.

pins.name: NoReuseBeforeDiscard
pins.says: Open-piece leftovers are discarded before their number is reused or a join is requested, and never count as closed pieces.

pins.name: WriteFailureStopsCapture
pins.says: A failed piece write prevents any further piece from that capture and reports that the recording cannot go on.

pins.name: JoinHasEveryClosedPiece
pins.says: A join is requested only after final capture end with no piece open, and includes every closed piece once in number order.

pins.name: NamedJoinIsComplete
pins.says: A named joined file is complete and contains at least one readable closed piece.

pins.name: UnreadablePiecesAreKept
pins.says: Pieces omitted as unreadable stay in the spool with the other closed pieces until hand-over and the retention period have passed.

pins.name: OnlyJoinedFileHandedOver
pins.says: Every hand-over uses the same recording identity and joined file, and the caller deduplicates retries so no piece or second file is handed over.

pins.name: HandedOverMeansConfirmed
pins.says: The recording counts as handed over only after confirmation of its joined file, and its retention period cannot expire before that confirmation.

pins.name: FailureKeepsTheRecording
pins.says: A failed join or hand-over keeps every closed piece and supplies its error and spool location, and a failed join hands over nothing.

pins.name: NoJoinOverExistingFile
pins.says: A whole joined file found on recovery is used for hand-over instead of attempting another join at its occupied name.

pins.name: NoEmptyJoin
pins.says: Finishing a recording with no closed piece reports that nothing was recorded and produces no join or hand-over.

pins.name: InterruptionLimitReportsFailure
pins.says: Reaching the interruption limit reports a failed join and waits for a new retry trigger after discarding any partial join.

pins.name: FailedRetryBudget
pins.says: Retrying a failed join resets its crash-interruption count to zero.

pins.name: TypeOK
pins.says: Every record field, command, caller effect and proof observation has its declared type.

pins.says: A recording can finish with nothing recorded.

---- MODULE RecordingPieces ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS MaxPieces, MaxInterruptions, MaxGapSeconds, Recording, JoinedFile, SpoolPath, ResetOnFailedRetry
VARIABLES online, phase, mode, known, disk, everClosed, open, hidden,
    writeBlocked, joinInput, joinTemp, joinedNamed, omitted, gaps,
    callerGaps, fileGaps, handed, archive, handKey, handTarget,
    keepPassed, interruptions, cutoff, error, retryBefore, retryAfter,
    changedClosed, recovered

\* One instance models one recording, identified by Recording, through its
\* lifetime. Bounds limit exploration, not production recording length.
\* Controller transitions save their complete record atomically before their
\* command can be executed. Disk and archive variables model caller reports and
\* effects; this component performs no I/O. Disk effects and acknowledgements
\* are separate so every relevant crash window is explored.
\* everClosed, changedClosed and retryBefore/retryAfter are proof observations.
\* The caller owns flushing, durable names, read-only joins, time measurement,
\* and hand-over deduplication by Recording. No progress is assumed of it.

Phases == {"capture", "paused", "write", "name", "discardOpen", "empty", "needJoin", "join", "nameJoin", "discardJoin", "joinFailed", "needHand", "hand", "handFailed", "kept", "needRemove", "remove", "done"}

EmptyGaps == [p \in {} |-> 0]

GapMaps == UNION { [s -> 1..MaxGapSeconds] : s \in SUBSET Pieces }

LastNamed == IF disk = {} THEN 0 ELSE CHOOSE p \in disk : \A q \in disk : q <= p

\* The finite sequence below is derived from the bound; no two-piece limit is
\* part of the contract. TLC's function-to-sequence interpretation is standard.
OrderedPieces(s) == LET n == Cardinality(s)
                       rank == [p \in s |-> Cardinality({q \in s : q <= p})]
                   IN [i \in 1..n |-> CHOOSE p \in s : rank[p] = i]

FailedRetryCount == IF ResetOnFailedRetry THEN 0 ELSE interruptions

Outcome == [status |-> phase, error |-> error, spool |-> SpoolPath,
            cannotContinue |-> writeBlocked, omitted |-> omitted, gaps |-> gaps]

ClosedPiecesProtected ==

    /\ (online /\ phase \in {"needRemove", "remove", "done"} => handed /\ keepPassed)

NameRequiresFlushedBytes ==

WholeMeansNamed ==

RecoveryUsesNamedPieces ==
    online /\ phase \notin {"name", "remove"} => known = disk

FreshPieceNumber ==
    online /\ phase = "write" => open = LastNamed + 1 /\ open \notin everClosed

    /\ (hidden # "absent" => open \in Pieces /\ open \notin disk)

WriteFailureStopsCapture ==
    writeBlocked => mode # "active" /\ phase \notin {"write", "name", "capture"}

JoinHasEveryClosedPiece ==
    online /\ phase \in {"join", "nameJoin"} =>

    joinedNamed => joinTemp = "absent" /\ Len(joinInput) > 0 /\ omitted \subseteq everClosed /\ omitted # everClosed

SavedGapsSurviveNaming ==
    /\ DOMAIN gaps = omitted
    /\ (phase = "nameJoin" \/ joinedNamed => gaps = callerGaps)
    /\ (joinedNamed => gaps = fileGaps)

UnreadablePiecesAreKept ==

    /\ (phase = "hand" => handKey = Recording /\ handTarget = JoinedFile /\ joinedNamed)
    /\ (handKey # "none" => handKey = Recording /\ handTarget = JoinedFile)

HandedOverMeansConfirmed ==

    /\ (keepPassed => handed)

FailureKeepsTheRecording ==
    phase \in {"joinFailed", "handFailed"} =>
        ~handed /\ disk = everClosed /\ Outcome.spool = SpoolPath /\
        IF phase = "joinFailed"
        THEN ~joinedNamed /\ archive = {} /\ error \in JoinErrors
        ELSE joinedNamed /\ error = "hand-io"

NoJoinOverExistingFile ==
    online /\ phase \in {"needJoin", "join", "discardJoin", "joinFailed"} => ~joinedNamed

NoEmptyJoin ==
    phase = "empty" => mode = "final" /\ disk = {} /\ ~joinedNamed /\ archive = {}

InterruptionLimitReportsFailure ==
    /\ (cutoff => interruptions = MaxInterruptions /\ error = "interrupted" /\ phase \in {"discardJoin", "joinFailed"})

pins.name: Spec
pins.says: The recording starts in Init and changes only through Next steps.

pins.name: ClosedPiecesProtected
pins.says: Closed pieces are never changed, and none is removed or requested for removal before confirmed hand-over and the end of the three-day retention period.

pins.name: NameRequiresFlushedBytes
pins.says: A piece is requested to receive its name only after the caller has reported all of its bytes flushed to disk.

pins.name: SavedGapsSurviveNaming
pins.says: The omitted pieces and their gap durations are saved before the joined file receives its name and remain available unchanged after it is named.

pins.name: WholeMeansNamed
pins.says: Only pieces with their names on disk count as whole, apart from a removal already in progress after retention.

pins.name: RecoveryUsesNamedPieces
pins.says: After recovery the record agrees with the named pieces on disk, allowing only an outstanding naming or removal acknowledgement to lag behind disk.

pins.name: FreshPieceNumber
pins.says: Each new piece uses the number after the last named piece and never reuses a closed piece number.

pins.name: NoReuseBeforeDiscard
pins.says: Open-piece leftovers are discarded before their number is reused or a join is requested, and never count as closed pieces.

pins.name: WriteFailureStopsCapture
pins.says: A failed piece write prevents any further piece from that capture and reports that the recording cannot go on.

pins.name: JoinHasEveryClosedPiece
pins.says: A join is requested only after final capture end with no piece open, and includes every closed piece once in number order.

pins.name: NamedJoinIsComplete
pins.says: A named joined file is complete and contains at least one readable closed piece.

pins.name: UnreadablePiecesAreKept
pins.says: Pieces omitted as unreadable stay in the spool with the other closed pieces until hand-over and the retention period have passed.

pins.name: OnlyJoinedFileHandedOver
pins.says: Every hand-over uses the same recording identity and joined file, and the caller deduplicates retries so no piece or second file is handed over.

pins.name: HandedOverMeansConfirmed
pins.says: The recording counts as handed over only after confirmation of its joined file, and its retention period cannot expire before that confirmation.

pins.name: FailureKeepsTheRecording
pins.says: A failed join or hand-over keeps every closed piece and supplies its error and spool location, and a failed join hands over nothing.

pins.name: NoJoinOverExistingFile
pins.says: A whole joined file found on recovery is used for hand-over instead of attempting another join at its occupied name.

pins.name: NoEmptyJoin
pins.says: Finishing a recording with no closed piece reports that nothing was recorded and produces no join or hand-over.

pins.name: InterruptionLimitReportsFailure
pins.says: Reaching the interruption limit reports a failed join and waits for a new retry trigger after discarding any partial join.

pins.name: FailedRetryBudget
pins.says: Retrying a failed join keeps its crash-interruption count from earlier attempts.

pins.name: TypeOK
pins.says: Every record field, command, caller effect and proof observation has its declared type.

pins.name: EmptyRecordingPossible
pins.says: A recording can finish with nothing recorded.

pins.name: ClosedRecordingPossible
pins.says: All closed pieces can be joined and handed over successfully.

pins.name: GappedRecordingPossible
pins.says: A recording can be handed over with an unreadable piece omitted, its gap duration reported and its original pieces retained.

pins.name: JoinFailurePossible
pins.says: A join can fail while retaining its closed pieces.

pins.name: AllUnreadableFailurePossible
pins.says: A join that cannot read any piece can fail without handing anything over.

pins.name: JoinRetryPossible
pins.says: A failed join can be attempted again with its closed pieces.

pins.name: HandFailurePossible
pins.says: Hand-over can fail while the joined file and all pieces are retained.

pins.name: HandRetryPossible
pins.says: A failed hand-over can be attempted again with the same identity and file.

pins.name: WriteFailurePossible
pins.says: A failed piece write can stop capture and leave earlier closed pieces ready to finish.

pins.name: InterruptedJoinLimitPossible
pins.says: Repeated crashes can reach the join interruption limit and report failure.

pins.name: FailedRetryAfterInterruptionPossible
pins.says: A join that failed at the interruption limit can be retried.

pins.name: CarryOnAfterRecoveryPossible

answers.question: If On Air dies after the joined file gets its name but before the join result is saved, how should the gap information survive?
answers.says: The caller reports the omitted pieces and gap durations before naming the joined file, and waits until this part has saved them.

answers.question: If On Air dies during hand-over before its result is saved, how should this part recover the unresolved hand-over?
answers.says: The part retries the same hand-over request after recovery, and the hand-over part deduplicates it using the recording’s stable identity.

answers.question: After hand-over explicitly reports failure, should this part retry it at the next launch or wait for the person to ask?
answers.says: Retry the same hand-over at the next launch and whenever the person asks.
